paragraphs.text: Alhammarret's Archive is an artifact and location on Vryn .

Alhammarret was a high arbiter and mind mage who arbitrated the warring factions of Vryn while secretly manipulating them to keep the conflict going so that he could retain his position. He was also the mentor of Jace Beleren and would send him to get intelligence from both sides. He, however, also manipulates Jace's mind during these missions. Alhammerret retained an archive that contained the totality of his notes, theories, and ponderings. The archive appears to be on a raised dais within some large building and has various plates and light orbs within it. Eventually, Jace discovered the truth and ended up killing Alhammarret by making him forget how to breathe, following which he planeswalked away. This left the archive without an owner, so it was potentially seized by one of Vryn's factions or forgotten about.
